title.rendered: Galatasaray agree €30m deal for Ugochukwu — Report

content.rendered:
Turkish champions Galatasaray have reached an agreement with Burnley to sign Super Eagles-eligible midfielder Lesley Ugochukwu in a deal worth just under €30 million.

Transfer expert Fabrizio Romano disclosed this on Sunday.

He said the 22-year-old is expected to complete his move to the Turkish club shortly.

“Here we go, confirmed: Lesley Ugochukwu will sign his contract at Galatasaray shortly.

“Deal worth under €30m package from Burnley for the midfielder,” Romano wrote on X.

Ugochukwu impressed for Burnley during the 2025/26 Premier League season despite the club’s relegation to the Championship.

The midfielder made 35 league appearances, scoring three goals and providing two assists.

Once the transfer is finalised, the Nigerian-born midfielder is expected to team up with Super Eagles striker Victor Osimhen at the Turkish giant.
